title: USA win *Backyard* Worlds, Belgians stop at 124
hook: Belgium's duo quit together after 124 yards; the USA take the team title.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: As of 22 Oct, 20:00 CEST, the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship is over. The USA win with 1,120 yards, led by Mark Dowdle's 107 yards.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: Merijn Geerts and Ivo Steyaert stopped together, so no individual winner. They passed the old best of 119 yards.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: Australia finished second on 1,069 yards, Belgium third on 1,058 and Japan fourth on 1,038. Canada set a national best of 830.

caption:
NEWS: USA win the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship

As of 22 Oct, 20:00 CEST, the race is over. The USA won with 1,120 yards, led by Mark Dowdle (107 yards). Belgium's Merijn Geerts and Ivo Steyaert stopped together after 124 yards each (about 824 km), past the previous best of 119. Australia took silver (1,069), Belgium bronze (1,058).

Source: Run247, Canadian Running
